name: Jetpack Compose
subtitle: Android's native UI toolkit
creator: Google
description: Google's recommended way to build native Android interfaces in Kotlin. Like SwiftUI, you describe the UI with functions, and Compose redraws what changes.
useCases: Apps using the newest Android features

concepts.explanation: Chainable size, padding and click behavior.

codeSamples.label: Kotlin

pros: Less code than old XML layouts
cons: Ecosystem still migrating from XML views

pricing.summary: Free with Android Studio. Google Play charges $25 once to publish.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
